about: Prompts for the blind-router check of the six agent-engine skills' descriptions. `expect` is the one skill that should be chosen; `alt` lists an acceptable second choice for a genuine overlap; `term` is a regular expression that must appear in the expected skill's description (set where a description carries a trigger, so it cannot lose it unnoticed). Used by tests/engine-routing-prompts.test.mjs and, by hand, to score blind routers. Prompts whose answer is a Phaser skill live in the agent-phaser plugin.

prompts.text: Which engine should an agent-built small 2D game use?
Wire a useFrame loop beside React state in a three.js game.
A thin-instanced mesh draws at the origin in Babylon.js.
Bring an agent-sprites atlas into a Godot project and say what was verified.
Add a GPU post-effect shader to our own canvas renderer.
My shooter looks like a demo; what would a VFX polish pass add to the explosions?
MeshToonMaterial bands come out grey in my React Three Fiber game.
My Babylon.js game runs at the wrong speed and positions come out mirrored.
An imported GLB is missing its animation clips in Unity; how do I check what the importer kept?
Can an agent author and verify a Fortnite level, or should we pick another engine?
Our own canvas renderer spends too long on CPU pixel lighting passes; can a GPU stage take over?
